cues.text:
Every example is built
from the same four ideas.

State is a set of typed fields
that every step can read.

A node is a plain function that reads
that state and returns an update.
An edge says what runs next,

and a conditional edge lets the
program decide at run time.

Open any example in Studio,
press Submit on a blank form,

and a ready-made case runs, so you
never need to know the data first.
